name: Kadiatou Hallberg-Acheampong
role: Electronic and physical observation expert — surveillance specialist
location: Crucible Square — open-air market, Tier 1-2 commerce, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Kadiatou Hallberg-Acheampong is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 65, the augmentation scarring around his temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He came up through the Shelf's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see him surpass them. He works as a surveillance specialist out of Crucible Square, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

he is not the most talented surveillance specialist in GLMZ, but he might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
core_desires: Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
blind_spots: Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Kadiatou Hallberg-Acheampong has been doubling fees to clients and pocketing the difference. The fixer who handles their contracts doesn't know. Yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
example_lines: "I've been watching you for three days. You should close your curtains."
"Information is the only commodity that appreciates with age."
"Everyone thinks they're careful. Nobody is careful enough."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Kadiatou Hallberg-Acheampong's reputation — and a price for silence
Kadiatou Hallberg-Acheampong is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A corporate black site Kadiatou Hallberg-Acheampong once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
narrative_function: Kadiatou Hallberg-Acheampong is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When he makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of his stories.
augmentations: Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation. Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible muscle definition — wiry rather than bulky. The synthetic muscle fiber in his legs gives him a slightly asymmetrical appearance, calves slightly fuller and more defined than natural aging would permit. Minimal body fat, carved by decades of discipline and chemical augmentation.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with residual black at the roots
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, naturally — alert and constantly assessing
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with warm undertones, weathered by age and exposure
physical_description.complexion: Deep facial lines around the eyes and mouth — the map of 65 years of tension and squinting at monitors. Jaw prominent and sharp. Skin texture rough in places where augmentation scarring has healed imperfectly.
distinguishing_marks: Chrome circuitry visible at both temples — silver-gray neural interface ports running from jawline to hairline, installed with functional brutality and minimal cosmetic finish.
Jagged scar tissue along the right jawline where the adrenaline pump was grafted, silvery-white and slightly raised.
Thin burn marks running down the inside of both forearms — old electrical contact scars from early maintenance mistakes.
A faded tattoo on his left shoulder blade: a runner's marker from the Shelf, now barely visible under sun damage.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome neural interface ports at temples and jawline are immediately obvious — deliberate, unapologetic exposure. The synthetic muscle fiber in his legs creates a subtle visual discontinuity in his calf definition and bulk. His movements are too fast, too precise for his age — the wired reflexes betray their presence in micro-adjustments and reaction speed.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight balanced, always ready to move. His gait is economical and quick, though he favors flat ground and visibly tenses on stairs — a tell that his leg augmentations don't handle inclines well. His head moves in small, precise rotations, scanning. Even at rest, his hands are never still — fidgeting with a contract chip, a surveillance scanner, something. A man wound too tight.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional wear with no pretense of style. Dark gray or black reinforced cargo pants with multiple pockets and a faint sheen of wear-resistant coating. A faded black synth-cotton shirt, sleeves pushed to the elbows to expose the augmentation scars — a statement of acceptance. Over it, a worn grey synthetic jacket with internal cable management and reinforced pockets for surveillance gear. Utilitarian boots, scuffed and re-soled multiple times. No jewelry, no chrome accents. Everything worn, everything practical, nothing decorative.
